items.pt: Termos de IPO da Anthropic a US$ 70-80 por acao, segundo a Reuters. Maior historia de mercado da janela e gancho direto de acesso.

opcoes.a: bankers priced it before the model could price itself. gud luck to whoever is in the allocation queue fr
opcoes.b: pricing is the easy part. the queue for it is the fun part - onchain the book fills instead of a favor list
opcoes.c: pricing an AI lab is pricing a bet on compute at 2029 margins. ngl the 70-80 is the least interesting number in this

items.pt: Trump Media comprou 1.510 BTC (mais de US$ 112 mi) no 3o trimestre. Tesouraria de companhia listada, cara de reply.

opcoes.a: so the earnings call is basically a candle chart now
opcoes.b: a treasury you can only read about once a quarter, while the thing it holds prints every second. thats the gap
opcoes.c: buying the quarter and calling it a strategy. we will see it in the 10-Q

items.pt: 14 companhias abertas venderam 108.247 BTC (US$ 8,08 bi) em 2026; MARA 40.581 BTC a media de US$ 74.446, Riot 20.264 a US$ 73.231.

opcoes.a: sold the coins, kept the newsletter
opcoes.b: 40k out the door does not fit in one candle. size like that needs a book that does not flinch - that is the job
opcoes.c: the treasury trade worked right up until everyone needed the same exit at the same time

items.pt: ByPick Season 2: voce tem uma tese sobre o proximo movimento do BTC e a proxima decisao de juros. Conta parceira, bom gancho de resposta.

opcoes.a: everyone has a view. almost nobody has a fill
opcoes.b: picking a side is easy. picking it after the bell, when the market is shut, thats the part nobody prices
opcoes.c: whoever says i called it first will be the one who did not size it

items.pt: Microsoft pediu a Trump que desista do banimento de tecnologia chinesa de data center de IA. Politica batendo em MAG7.

opcoes.a: an AI company asking for fewer bans. boldlitely predictable
opcoes.b: policy drops at 11am. the tape stops at 4. holders find out monday
opcoes.c: the call for less regulation always comes with a footnote about who it protects

posts.text_en:
an IPO decides who gets in on day one.
liquidity decides who is in on day two, day thirty, and at 3am on a sunday.

two different markets. only one of them is priced.

not a market.
